### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked" (post the loyalty credit now): excluded by the posting card's state-form sentence (current term has not started on 2026-11-01 on Price Lock 24) and, for its amount, by the referral sentence. Posting it would also read the loyalty card figure of a plan not yet renewed into.
- Accept the renewal at 11.89 (bare offered rate): excluded by renewal_offer_acceptance "at the renewal rate determined for that agreement rather than the bare offered rate" and the factor docs; accepting before restoring the July dual-fuel line is excluded by the "fixed only after" sentence (bundle tier would be 0.15 not 0.30).
- Loyalty billing_period_start 2026-09-01 or 2026-10-01: excluded by "the bill of the billing cycle that starts with the new term". New term start 2026-09-24 (election date): excluded by rule 2 (election before end date → day after end date).
- Referral credit on cycle 2026-11-01: excluded by "the bill of the billing cycle in progress on the posting date".
- Restoring cycle 2026-09-01: excluded by "missed on a past billing cycle"; cycles before 2025-02-01: excluded by rule 3 (gas not active on cycle start).
- Fall-back numbers: dual-fuel 5.00, renewal rate 11.89, referral 50.00, loyalty 50.00 — each computable from its computation doc + named product figure, each different from the answer.
- Factor findability: every factor document was reached through record words — gas agreement status/plan name/term (uplift, bundle bonuses, whole-home therms), dual-fuel credit lines by cycle (compensation, bundle reduction), enrollment_channel and notice delivery_channel (paperless), service_start_date (tenure), energy-line kWh (usage, volume), referral lines (count, referral loyalty), notice dates (early election, season), contract end / plan change dates (commitment, renewed term), posted lines (spend).
